purpose: Transcribe, WITH EXACT SOURCE CITATIONS AND UNMODIFIED STATUS TAGS, the scientific-gate parameter values the Yass Component B spec proposes, so that named human owners can later record real, dated sign-off. This record approves nothing by itself. It converts the scattered gate items into one auditable slate of PROPOSED values + open decisions + placeholder approver slots. It authorizes no scientific behavior, no session start, no BE4, no pilot, and no production use.
source_authority_note: Per Dev/backend/buildLog.md's source-authority ladder, governance decisions and provenance records outrank the generator spec, which outranks the generator implementation. This record outranks neither existing governance records (component-b-closure-decisions.json, component-b-live-engine-reuse-map.json, component-b-profile-classroom-ratification.json) nor the frozen consts in runtime-bundle.schema.json. Where this record and the schema both speak to a value, the schema's const is authoritative and is reproduced here as FROZEN, not reopened.

gate_items.spec_reference_table_label: per-population research priors, non-executable as direct TD/MLD/DD rules
gate_items.proposed_value: See spec_reference_table (21 rows, 7 skills x 3 populations) above; NOT a proposed set of 7 live population-neutral values.
gate_items.spec_status_tag: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION · CALIBRATION_PENDING (every one of the 21 rows, per spec §6.2.1)
gate_items.live_engine_requirement: Yass/Implementation_v1.0/component_b_generator/bkt/config.py (BBKTConfig) requires exactly 7 population-neutral, skill-keyed SkillBKTParams (P(L0)/P(T)/P(G)/P(S)) with NO production default; skill_params must cover exactly the 7 frozen skills. It has no population axis and rejects any 'population'/'dd_subtype' field (extra="forbid").
gate_items.structural_constraint_note: bkt/config.py's SkillBKTParams enforces P(G)+P(S) < 1 and P(G) <= 0.5 in code (model_validator _structural_constraints); any future population-neutral values must pass these checks, matching spec §6.1 FROZEN rules.
open_questions: How the 7 population-neutral live BKT parameterizations are derived is UNRESOLVED and requires the named academic/calibration owner. This record does not pick a rule (not TD-row adoption, not averaging, not any other derivation) — no population-neutral BKT values are approved and the engine remains fail-closed until they are.

The 2026-07-13 clarification (spec, top-of-document note) declares the per-population priors NON-EXECUTABLE as direct TD/MLD/DD rules in the deployable baseline (SF-039); population is LATENT_GENERATOR_ONLY (spec §2/§4) and never exported, and is also a prohibited synthetic latent per component-b-live-engine-reuse-map.json's explicitly_prohibited_from_application list (hidden learner truth / synthetic learner traits).
EM-refit and pilot-refit on real data (spec §6.1 'Fit source' row, B-008) have not occurred for any candidate live values.
gate_items.notes: This entry deliberately does not collapse the 21 rows into 7 live values. It records the table for provenance, records the live 7-row requirement from bkt/config.py, and records the derivation method as an open decision for the named owner.
